# `MountMode`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mount switched between equatorial and alt-az mode.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only; receiving the event changes nothing) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, SetEqModeCmd @0xf0aa0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart present |

Custom guider producer, no state or error. Sent after a mount-mode command succeeds. Emitted by the guider on TCP 4400 to every retained socket; the main imager process forwards the line unchanged onto TCP 4700 (the auxiliary imager process suppresses guider forwarding). The imager also installs a local callback for this name. Overlaps the equ_mode member of scope_get_state and the mount section of get_device_state. APK consumer: the device-state mount handler.

Side effects: None for the receiver; the device sends this without a request.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"MountMode"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `equ_mode` | boolean | yes | - | true for equatorial mode. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, eq - Equatorial mode set (READ shape):

```json
{"Event":"MountMode","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","equ_mode":true}
```
